workload: Ten newly authored three-file tasks: two each about positional arguments, UTF-8 size and last separator; two intended multi-edit combinations, one legacy arithmetic and one unsupported semantic control. All tasks count even if the actual repair differs from the anticipated edit.
freeze: Hash the two-language fixtures, independent TIDE oracle, search implementation, original-to-new inspector patch and runner before drawing random seed. Rank 0..65535 by SHA256(seed:task:id). Remove duplicates including all public inputs. The repair tools receive public cases only. Hidden acceptance once after writing the source. Audit all original outputs across languages on the same 720 cases.
policy: Both arms consider visited definitions on the first failing example, cap trials at 32 singles/64 two-file pairs. First try classic operators and existing small arithmetic rewrites, then structural singles only if no classic singleton edit passes. For pairs, consider classic/classic first. If none passes, use the remaining slots for pairs involving a structural edit. Argument swaps of equal-type positional parameters, text length to UTF-8 bytes, full-text forward find to reverse find. Choose first public green sorted by file, numeric source position, replacement spelling. Report any search truncation, disagreement or hidden failure. No adaptive feedback.
timing: 12 four-arm blocks per task plus one unrecorded warmup. Fresh scratch projects, installed TIDE before/after; CPython equivalent classic/extended search. Python searches and applies together, uses a fresh minimal interpreter for held-out acceptance. TIDE uses its normal test/edit/test CLI. Clock starts before diagnosis, stops after independent acceptance or abstention. Monotonic wall time including process startup. Warm caches, rotating task order and balanced arm order, single pinned CPU, loopback only. Report per-task medians, median paired ratio/dispersion, failures separately, before/after on identical inputs.
tokens: Zero additional model calls. Separately count one deterministic transcript per unique task and arm: public contract, original three sources, public cases, compact diagnosis with passing candidates, decision and final status.
